Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

I want to give you a clear, direct update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for launch is taking longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, and that certification step is outside our control but essential before we can move forward safely. As a result, the project schedule has shifted by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing to build and test everything else on schedule in parallel, so this delay is isolated to the certification dependency rather than a reflection of broader project health, and we will use the additional time to run extra validation so the launch is as stable as possible.

Does 14 April work on your end, or are there any downstream dates on your side that this shift would affect? We will keep you updated with any progress on the certification, and please let us know if you would like a status call this week to walk through the details.
